title: Rollers services
description: A ruled band: a two-tone statement in a Helvetica-style grotesk in the left half and, past a vertical hairline, a stack of services, each an orange title over a short paragraph, separated by full-width hairlines. Lines draw in, words rise, items fade up.
notes: the statement and titles read the rollers theme's --typeface-grotesk and fall back to the body face
